title: Kissed Smoky French Cheese Gratin
description: A smoky, cheesy French dish from the Alsace region, featuring canned tomatoes and bonito flakes, cooked in a donabe vessel. This Buddhist-temple-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed canned tomatoes and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until it is fully melted and the mixture is smooth.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes over the top of the cheese mixture.
Arrange the cubed baguette over the top of the bonito flakes.
Transfer the donabe vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the donabe vessel from the oven and sprinkle the chopped fresh thyme over the top.
